hero._note: Treatments page (/treatments/) hero: the big heading and the line under it.
hero.heading: Treatments
hero.text: Facials, body slimming and spa treatments shaped around you, with the warm care and proven technology we’ve been known for since 1984.

services._note: Heading above the Face / Body / Wellness tiles on /treatments/. Put *asterisks* around words to show them in italic rose. Each tile's treatment count, starting price and peek list come from the treatments below automatically.
services.heading: Explore our *services*
services.lede: Three ways to feel like you, each one personalised by our therapists.

trending._note: New & trending banners on /treatments/ (below the Face/Body/Wellness tiles). One wide banner on top (1920 x 480) and two half-width banners under it (960 x 480 each), in that order. image = a file path in public/images/banners/, or "" for a placeholder. Any words should be part of the image itself. alt = what the banner says or shows, for screen readers. link = where it goes when clicked, e.g. "/rituals/?area=face" (or "" for no link). Write the heading with *asterisks* around the words to show in italic rose. No before-and-after images or guaranteed results.
trending.heading: This season's *spotlight*
trending.lede: New arrivals and the rituals our guests keep coming back for. Tap one to take a closer look.

photos._note: Photos for treatments in the menu workbook, by treatment name (files in public/images/treatments/). The workbook's "Image file" column wins over this list. Run `npm run build:treatments` after changing it.

filters._note: Rituals page (/rituals/) filter pills. The treatments, concerns (labels, order, shortlists) and collections come from the menu workbook via `npm run build:treatments` (src/data/treatment-menu.json). budgets match the "from" price shown on each card; durations match any of a treatment's session lengths.
